T: The game is back. So is lunch.
D: The friends return to Jumanji to rescue Spencer, but the game has changed and two grandpas got sucked in too.
P: Serve the mains when the group is back at the diner at the end.
S: the long chase across the desert dunes

Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar and grilled until charred, served with garlicky hummus and a chopped tomato, cucumber and mint salad. Mix 3 tbsp za'atar with 4 tbsp olive oil and brush over 4 flatbreads. Grill or chargrill for 2 minutes a side until blistered, then cut into wedges. Blitz a drained can of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, a garlic clove, lemon juice, salt and a splash of water until smooth. Dice 3 tomatoes and a Lebanese cucumber and toss with mint, lemon and oil.
the mandrills on the swinging rope bridges
Banana slices dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed peanuts, frozen 30 minutes on a tray.
the green jungle at the start of the game
Pineapple, mango, papaya and lychee cubes in cups with lime juice, mint and a little chilli salt.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato and brown sugar and baked sticky, with creamy mash, green beans and gravy. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, a grated onion, an egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Spread with 100ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Steam 300g green beans. Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and stock.
Jurgen the Brutal's snowy mountain fortress
Beef chuck browned with onions and lots of sweet paprika, simmered 3 hours with tomato and capsicum until thick, served with buttered noodles and sour cream.
W: the Falcon jewel they have to steal back
Green jelly set in glasses with diced kiwifruit and grapes, topped with whipped cream and a green grape on top like a gem.
K: crossing the desert with no water
Watermelon blended with lime juice and mint, strained and poured over ice in tall glasses.

s.note: the mandrills on the swinging rope bridges
s.how: Slice 3 bananas into thick rounds. Melt 150g dark chocolate and dip each slice halfway, then roll the chocolate side in crushed peanuts. Lay on a lined tray and freeze for 30 minutes until set. Serve straight from the freezer.

s.note: the green jungle at the start of the game
s.how: Cube half a pineapple, a mango and half a papaya and mix with a drained can of lychees. Spoon into cups, squeeze over lime juice and scatter with torn mint. Finish each cup with a pinch of salt mixed with chilli for a little kick.

m.note: Jurgen the Brutal's snowy mountain fortress
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 sliced onions and 3 tbsp sweet paprika and stir for a minute. Add a can of crushed tomatoes, a sliced red capsicum and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until thick and serve over buttered egg noodles.

w.note: the Falcon jewel they have to steal back
w.how: Make up 2 packets of lime jelly and pour into clear glasses with diced kiwifruit and halved green grapes. Chill for 3 hours until set. Top with whipped cream and finish each glass with one perfect green grape like a jewel.

d.note: crossing the desert with no water
d.how: Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and a handful of mint until smooth. Strain into a jug and chill well. Pour over ice in tall glasses with a fresh mint sprig on top. Cool relief after crossing the dunes.
